mock-api-seam.name: Mock API seam
notes: Keep a fake API module's function names and return shapes identical to the real one so swapping in fetch calls doesn't touch the pages.

stale-response-guard-in-useeffect.name: Stale response guard in useEffect
notes: An ignore flag set in the effect cleanup stops a slow, outdated request from overwriting state after the input changed or the component unmounted.

plain-date-strings-for-due-dates.name: Plain date strings for due dates
notes: Storing due dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings and comparing them to today's local date avoids time zone bugs that come with Date objects.

router-state-handoff.name: Router state handoff
notes: navigate(path, { state }) passes one-time data like a new task's id to the next page without putting it in the URL.
